findings_and_fixes.fix: model from COLLECTOR_GEMINI_MODEL (default gemini-2.5-flash); no video id means no request; keys read from secret files and sent via x-goog-api-key header (also YouTube)

findings_and_fixes.failure: state/status written to /data but only bundles and state were mounted

requirements.lock generated with uv pip compile (torch 2.15.0+cpu, no nvidia/cuda/triton lines), Dockerfile installs it with --no-deps and the CPU wheel index

findings_and_fixes.failure: PTT Stock index lists pinned posts twice -> duplicate item_id aborted the bundle; T86/NDC/Threads/IG/CMoney ended 'complete' with 0 items; T86 asked for a day whose data is not yet published
findings_and_fixes.fix: parse_ptt_index de-duplicates by article id; runner marks a run with zero requests 'partial' reason=no_targets and zero items 'partial' reason=no_data_for_date (manifest.reason, status.json reason, CLI output); T86 targets latest_published_trading_date (before 15:00 Taiwan time = previous weekday)
findings_and_fixes.note: Through the CLI runner path with a fake transport every network source issues >=1 request (parametrized test), so the 0-item runs were real responses with nothing parseable (e.g. login-walled Threads/IG, unpublished T86 day) now surfaced as partial/no_data_for_date rather than complete

followup_20261111.root_cause: scrapling 0.2.99 imports browserforge/apify-fingerprint-datapoints (via camoufox); lock lacked them so 'import scrapling.fetchers' raised and LiveScraplingTransport silently fell back to urllib. 0.2.99 has PlayWrightFetcher, not DynamicFetcher.
fixes: fetchers.py: ImportError/browser-launch failure now raises FetchBackendUnavailableError (no urllib fallback); runner writes a partial bundle with reason=fetch_failed and re-raises
requirements.lock/.txt: added browserforge==1.2.4, apify-fingerprint-datapoints==0.16.0 (+ explicit camoufox, playwright pins); browser class is PlayWrightFetcher
Dockerfile: playwright install --with-deps chromium into /ms-playwright (apt chromium removed)
runner: zero-item reasons are no_targets / fetch_failed (non-2xx or request error) / parse_zero; no_data_for_date only when collector sets no_data_confirmed

NDC: ZIP member was matched with endswith so schema-景氣指標與燈號.csv was parsed instead of 景氣指標與燈號.csv (0 items in 4s); now exact basename match. All requests are logged (logger collector_stack.fetch) and kept in fetcher.request_log
